optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Embedded Software Engineer, Agricultural Machinery Controllers

professionalSummary.text: Embedded software engineer with five years of experience implementing controller functions for agricultural machinery harvesters under team software standards, testing on bench rigs, and supporting field test programs with diagnostics.
professionalSummary.witness: Embedded software engineer on the harvester controller team of an agricultural machinery maker for five years, implementing controller functions against the machine engineers' function specifications under the team's software standard.

professionalSummary.text: Documented release limitations and hand-over conditions for field test teams, coordinated function changes with machine engineers via change logs, and managed software review processes with release approvals handled by the controller software lead.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each release note for the field test team.

experienceHighlights.text: Implemented controller functions against machine engineers' specifications under team software standards for five years on harvester controller team.
experienceHighlights.witness: Embedded software engineer on the harvester controller team of an agricultural machinery maker for five years, implementing controller functions against the machine engineers' function specifications under the team's software standard.

experienceHighlights.text: Tested functions on bench rig with attached test records and supported field test program for two harvest seasons using controller logs for diagnostics.
experienceHighlights.witness: Tested each function on the bench rig with the rig test records attached to the change, and supported the field test programme for two harvest seasons with diagnostics from the controller logs.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed software review process with release approvals recorded by controller software lead, as documented in release records.
experienceHighlights.witness: Took each change through the software review process; the release approval was the controller software lead's, recorded in the release record.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated function changes with machine engineers through function change log, documenting proposed changes and those from machine engineers.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated function changes with the machine engineers through the function change log, recording which changes I proposed and which came from the machine engineers.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented release limitations and hand-over conditions in release notes for field test teams.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each release note for the field test team.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided two change records with rig test records and release approvals, one season's diagnostics summary, and one release note with limitation section, all with software repository references for verification.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: two change records with rig test records and release approvals, one season's diagnostics summary and one release note with its limitation section, with the software repository references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Embedded software development for agricultural machinery controllers, including function implementation, bench testing, field diagnostics, and release documentation.
skills.witness: Embedded software engineer on the harvester controller team of an agricultural machinery maker for five years, implementing controller functions against the machine engineers' function specifications under the team's software standard.
